full_details: Before you left the lodging the almanac said no play, and you did not write a title on the struck line. The streets up to Holywell were swept and silent. Watchmen at the gate looked at every face. You read the forty leaves at James's table, every voice. At the hollow crown Dick put his hand flat on the table and left it there. At the deposing nobody moved. John asked where it was written that you could, this week, and he asked it twice in one sentence. James named Friday's gallows. George said send it to the Master whole, and let the cutting be his. That was agreed. Kemp came at the fourth act, heard the end, and asked where he came in. You told him he was late, and that it was already done. Dick took the leaves home under his arm and did not ask. You wrote "no play" on your tables, and you did not write the name of the bill that was struck. At supper you paid twopence for the horn and threepence for the board. The loaf is still a full thumb short of the notch. The king is not licensed and not billed. Nothing of a new play was opened.
one_sentence: You read the king through to the fellows, and Dick took the forty leaves under his arm.
title: Read the king to the fellows
